title: Ajllitanakar aljantirinaka
intro: Nayratpachaw Diosan khitanakapax jaqinak taypin sarnaqapxirïna, ukat yaqhip jakʼankirinakax janiw qhana uñtʼapkänti. Aka sarnaqäwix pä almanakatw muyunti, jupanakan profetjam jak’achasiñapax yant’awiparuw tukuwayi, ukat herenciapax mä jan pachani yatichäwiwa.
clues: Jachʼa profetanakan tiempopanwa jakasipjjayäta, ukampis kunatï cheqäki uk apanipkäna ukanak uñjasajj nayranakajajj jistʼantatänwa.
Utanakajajj Diosan qhanañchäwinakapamp phoqantatänwa, ukampis chuymanakajajj chʼamañchtʼatäjjänwa.
Kunapachatï castigojj purinkäna ukhajja, janiw arcan imantasiñ thaqapjjerïkti, janirakiw nina nakhaskir jallutsa jaltjjapkti, kunattejj ewjjtʼanakat sawkasipjjerïtwa.
Quran qillqatanx mä uñacht’äwiw khitinakatix jan iyawsapki jupanakataki, uñacht’ayasa, mä profetampis jak’at apasiñas janiw qhispiykiti.
Jiwasax Nuh ukat Lut chachan warmipäpxtwa, jupanakax jupanakar aljantapxänwa, ukhamatwa juchañchatäpxäna.

trial.label: ¿Kuna yantʼas jupanakan uñjasipjjäna?
options: Jupanakajj profetanakampi casaratäpjjänwa, ukampis janiw creyipkänti
Jupanakax Iblis ukan yant’ataw utanakapat sarxapxäna
trial.answer: Jupanakajj profetanakampi casaratäpjjänwa, ukampis janiw creyipkänti

location.label: ¿Kunampis jupanakan destinopajj watatäpjjäna?
options: Uma jalsu ukat qalanakan jallu puritapa
location.answer: Uma jalsu ukat qalanakan jallu puritapa

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
